data: {"generalSituation":"Winds will be weak and the weather will be generally fine and very hot over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The area of low pressure near Hainan Island will move in the general direction of the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next couple of days, bringing unsettled weather to the region. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Dolphin will move across the Ryukyu Islands and the East China Sea. It will then move towards the vicinity of Zhejiang and northern part of Fujian. Under the influence of the outer subsiding air of Dolphin, the weather will be extremely hot during the day over southern China from the weekend to early next week. High temperatures will also trigger thundery showers. A southwesterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week.
